title: [P2][inventory,polish] Sparkline endpoint highlight per the approved mockup
goal: docs/design/pages/inventory.md's v2 target explicitly calls for marking the latest point on the price sparkline ('give sparklines the same care as type'); sparkline.tsx still renders a flat single-color polyline with no endpoint marker, on both the item card and item-detail price-trend card.
in_scope: Add an endpoint marker (dot or equivalent) to the latest data point in sparkline.tsx, applied consistently to both its item-card and item-detail usages.
out_of_scope: Any other sparkline styling change beyond the endpoint marker -- REQ-29/E-23's broader token rollout (S-100) covers color/shadow values separately.
Changing the underlying price-history data the sparkline renders.
acceptance: The price sparkline marks its latest data point distinctly, per docs/design/pages/inventory.md's v2 target, on both the item card and item-detail price-trend card.
invariants: The endpoint marker must not visually clutter the sparkline at its smallest rendered size (item card) -- verify legibility at both card and detail-page sizes.
